purpose: Verified publication-gate contract for reviewing whether a property case file meets the conditions for a verified citizen-facing answer.
core_principle: REVIEW ALL MATERIAL DEPENDENCIES → FAIL CLOSED ON MATERIAL GAPS → PUBLISH ONLY THE SUPPORTED STATE
publication_rule: VERIFIED_ANSWER requires every material gate to pass; VERIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS requires the remaining limitation to be non-material and explicit.
fail_closed_rule: A material failed gate prevents definitive publication.
review_rule: The review result must identify failed checks and required remediation rather than only returning a generic failure.
verification_boundary: The quality gate validates completeness and publication readiness of the case file; it does not independently establish the underlying property or legal truth.
